param.name: TitanLRS:TX_PKT_RATE
param.documentation: Over-the-air packet rate and modulation, as the ExpressLRS rate number (the same on all hardware). The number also selects the band: 0-19 sub-GHz, 20-39 2.4 GHz, 100+ dual band. Rates this TX or the handset link cannot run are refused. The link re-syncs to the new rate. (Each TX supports a subset; see TX_PKT_HZ for the rate in Hz.)

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_PKT_HZ
param.documentation: Over-the-air packets per second at the current packet rate.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_TLM_RATIO
param.documentation: Share of packets used for telemetry from the receiver. Fixed at 1:2 in MAVLink link mode.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_SWITCH_MODE
param.documentation: How the AUX channels are sent. 4-channel rates: 0 Wide, 1 Hybrid. Full rates: 0 8ch, 1 16ch Rate/2, 2 12ch Mixed. Fixed at Hybrid / 16ch Rate/2 in MAVLink link mode.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_ANT_MODE
param.documentation: How the TX uses its two radios. Dual band (X-Band) rates always use Gemini. The receiver follows this setting. (TX with two radios only.)

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_LINK_MODE
param.documentation: Normal carries RC and CRSF telemetry; MAVLink carries a MAVLink link to the GCS. Setting Normal ends this MAVLink session and the receiver changes to CRSF. At boot the TX returns to MAVLink if a GCS is sending MAVLink to it before a handset connects.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_POWER
param.documentation: Maximum TX output power. With dynamic power on, the TX lowers its power below this when the link allows. (Each TX supports a range of these levels.)

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_DYN_POWER
param.documentation: Off holds the max power. Dyn adjusts the power to the link quality. AUX9-AUX12 adjust it too, and boost to max power while that channel is high.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_FAN_THRESH
param.documentation: Power level at which the TX turns its fan on. (TX with a fan only.)

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_BP_TLM
param.documentation: How the TX backpack forwards telemetry. Off also cuts a GCS that is connected through the backpack. (ESP32 TX with a backpack enabled only.)

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_GCSOVR_ENABLE
param.documentation: Lets the GCS joystick (RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE) take over the channels in TX_GCSOVR_MASK while the handset holds TX_GCSOVR_CH high. Taken-over channels hold the handset's position until the GCS sets them. The TX never passes a GCS's RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE on to the vehicle, whether this is on or not. MAVLink link mode only.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_GCSOVR_CH
param.documentation: Handset channel that hands the TX_GCSOVR_MASK channels to the GCS while high. Setting it clears that channel from TX_GCSOVR_MASK. Listed while TX_GCSOVR_ENABLE is 1.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_GCSOVR_MASK
param.documentation: Channels taken from the GCS while the override is enabled. The enable channel (TX_GCSOVR_CH) is never taken. CH9-CH16 need MAVLink2 from the GCS. They go over the air at the resolution the switch mode gives them. Listed while TX_GCSOVR_ENABLE is 1.

param.name: TitanLRS:TX_VEH_SYSID
param.documentation: System ID of the vehicle the TX has joined, taken from the flight controller's heartbeat. 0 until one has been seen.

param.name: TitanLRS:RX_PROTOCOL
param.documentation: Protocol on the receiver's serial port. Follows the TX link mode: MAVLink while the TX is in MAVLink mode, CRSF otherwise. Change TX_LINK_MODE to leave MAVLink.

param.name: TitanLRS:RX_PROTOCOL2
param.documentation: Protocol on the receiver's second serial port. (Receivers with a second serial port.)

param.name: TitanLRS:RX_TLM_POWER
param.documentation: Receiver output power for telemetry. 0 matches the TX power. Writing it drops the link for a moment while the receiver saves. (Each receiver supports a range of these levels.)

param.name: TitanLRS:RX_ANT_MODE
param.documentation: Antenna the receiver uses. Writing it drops the link for a moment while the receiver saves. (Single-radio receivers with an antenna switch only; receivers with two radios follow TX_ANT_MODE.)

param.name: TitanLRS:RX_TGT_SYSID
param.documentation: System ID of the flight controller the receiver sends RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE to. Writing it drops the link for a moment while the receiver saves.

param.name: TitanLRS:RX_SRC_SYSID
param.documentation: System ID the receiver sends RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE and RADIO_STATUS from. Must match the flight controller's GCS system ID (ArduPilot MAV_GCS_SYSID / SYSID_MYGCS) for the overrides to be used. Writing it drops the link for a moment while the receiver saves.

param.name: TitanLRS:RX_MODEL_ID
param.documentation: Model ID the receiver is bound to for Model Match. 255 means Model Match is off.
